fact: ZTE Corporation (China) committed US$150 million, an AidData estimate of an equal split with China Development Bank, of a US$300 million loan to Econet Wireless Zimbabwe for network expansion and new services, announced 4 December 2015.
system: ZTE vendor-credit share of USD 300 million syndicated loan to Econet Wireless Zimbabwe

fact: China Development Bank and ZTE Corporation (both China) provided a US$300 million loan to Econet Wireless Zimbabwe, channelled from a US$500 million group facility, for ICT market consolidation and new services, per Econet Wireless Zimbabwe's CEO; the split between the two lenders is not given.

Econet Infrastructure Company (InfraCo), the privately run, VFEX-listed Econet tower, power and property arm in Zimbabwe, reported US$10.944 million of capital expenditure authorised and contracted for at 31 August 2026, to be financed from its own cash flow and further funding to be arranged.
